Yukky!
Oct 2019
Jetstar provided us with a voucher as out flight was delayed by 6 hours. Had to walk to the far reaches of the airport. Vey rude man showed us the 'menu' for vouchers however most items were not available. The voucher entitled us to one meal and a drink. As kid for Pepsi light but told only regular Pepsi came with the voucher. He could not explain why even though it is the same price. Settled on chicken and rice. It consisted of luke warm piece of fat, bone and gristle that looked like the backbone of a carcas plus a small cup of cold rice. Needless to say we did not eat any of it. I've contacted Jetstar to suggest that they never use this establishment again.

Cheap, cheerful, and ridiculously friendly
Jul 2019 • Solo
So, my time in Vietnam was over, I'd survived the immigration queue, and then I discovered Fresh 2 Go. Now, their menu consisted of one main thing: A pork roll. I didn't really want one, but they were damn cheap, and the Vietnamese guy was hilarious, and really good. He told me "If you don't like it, I'll pay for it."

I bought one, and annoyingly, he didn't have to pay for it.

Genuinely, Vietnam amazed me at how friendly and open everyone was, and this was one final perfect example of this. I even tried to tip the guy, he was so good, but he told me "I don't want tip, it makes me happy to serve you." 

Blimey.

Forgive me, I didn't get his name, but did get his photo.

If you're not vegetarian, go and give this place a shot !
